shortDescription: Fluence Energy Inc. NASDAQ:FLNC fell 18.78% premarket after cutting fiscal 2026 revenue guidance to approximately $2.4 billion from a prior midpoint of $3.0 billion. children: fell 18.78% premarket after cutting fiscal 2026 revenue guidance to approximately $2.4 billion from a prior midpoint of $3.0 billion. Adjusted EBITDA guidance went to a loss of roughly $200 million from a previous midpoint loss of $10 million.

CEO Julian Nebreda attributed the revision primarily to delays ramping up the company's contract manufacturing facility in Houston, while saying demand remains strong domestically and internationally and the international supply chain continues to perform. The contract manufacturer has implemented corrective actions that have already lifted daily production, and Fluence is restructuring its operational organization and streamlining planning across supply chain, manufacturing and delivery.

CFO Ahmed Pasha said converting backlog into revenue and cash while optimizing working capital is the key focus, with the objective of generating neutral to positive operating cash flow to support the backlog without external capital. Fluence also appointed Bernerd Da Santos as COO, previously an operational leader at AES. A detailed fiscal 2027 plan comes with the full-year results.

title: Fluence Falls 19% After Slashing Fiscal 2026 Guidance
